The appearance settings and the jobs page rebuilt against BombVault's own source rather than against the design language. The engine is unchanged.

## 🎨 Design

- **Every selector segment now takes its own position in the palette.** They all took the single accent, so with rainbow mode on a three-way picker read as one accent and two greys where the same control in BombVault reads as three colours. That was true of every picker on the settings page, and it is most of what "this does not look like the other apps" meant. Switch groups had the same gap: each row now carries its own position, so three switches read as three settings rather than as one setting with three parts.
- **Accent and rainbow are one card, and it comes last.** The accent is the palette's position zero, so somebody changing one is looking at the other; two cards put the palette a card away from the colour it starts with.
- **Every colour swatch opens the picker.** It used to take a second click on the already chosen one, which made the picker effectively invisible. There are eight presets rather than five now, the same eight in the same order as the other apps here.
- **A swatch keeps its size when you pick it.** The selected one wore an outline, which is drawn outside the box, so it grew by four pixels and the whole row shifted on every click. Now only the border's colour moves.
- **Both reset controls are always present**, disabled when there is nothing to undo, at the end of the row they reset. A control that appears only once it has work to do is one nobody knows about until they have already made the mess.
- **The settings cards are capped at a reading width.** They ran the full width of the window, so a label sat at the far left and its control a thousand pixels away at the right.
- **The settings tabs have glyphs**, all three of them.
- **One card per job.** A job has a name, a state, two sides, a schedule and its own actions; it was a row separated from the next by a hairline, and a hairline between two subjects says less than a surface around each. Each card carries its own palette position.
- **A switch that cannot act is dimmed** rather than left live and inert.

## ⚡ Improved

- **A selector no longer wraps onto a second line to keep its segments the same width.** Four options at the shared minimum need more room than a card in a reading column has, and the last one folded underneath. Segments now shrink together where there is no room and stay pinned where there is.

## 🗑️ Removed

- **The "Right now" card at the top of the jobs page.** It described a running job by name while the list below described the same job again, so the top one had to be read first to find out which row to look at. The file being moved and the side it lands on now sit on the job making them.
